references.text: God commands Moses to write down the song as a witness against the children of Israel, which is fulfilled in verse 22.
This is the very song that Moses wrote down and taught the children of Israel, known as the Song of Moses.
An earlier song Moses composed to teach the children of Israel, after the exodus from Egypt and the crossing of the Red Sea.
Moses presents the song he wrote before the entire assembly of Israel.
Moses' instruction to teach God's words to the children, reflected in his teaching the song to the children of Israel.
The command to diligently teach God's words to the children, which Moses practiced by teaching them the song.
The tradition of teaching God's testimony and law to the next generation, as Moses did with the song.
